what_this_is: Real earnings-event shocks for DELL, DVN and GOOGL -- the 3 anchor tickers HYP-05's round-4 reverse search sourced peers (CNXN, NGS, TTWO respectively) for, and which have zero rows in HYP-04's own HYP04_ANCHOR_SHOCKS_2026-08-31.csv because they never qualified under anchor_universe.py's DIFFERENT, own-disclosure-direction rule. See module docstring.
what_this_is_not: This does NOT add DELL, DVN or GOOGL to HYP-04's anchor universe, does not touch HYP04_ANCHOR_EVENT_CALENDAR_*.csv or HYP04_ANCHOR_SHOCKS_2026-08-31.csv (neither read nor writable by this module), and moves no HYP-04 gate condition. It is HYP-05-side evidence only.

rules.dedup_rule: one anchor event per (anchor_ticker, release_date); the earliest ACCEPTANCE wins, ties broken on accession -- the identical rule anchor_calendar.DEDUP_RULE states, applied here directly to unwrapped CandidateEvents because there is no membership interval to place them into

lineage_check: CNXN/DELL as_of 2022-03-14 -> CIK 0001571996, one continuous filer since the 2013 Dell LBO, RENAMED (not re-incorporated) from 'Denali Holding Inc.' to 'Dell Technologies Inc' in 2016 -- 2022 is 6 years inside the renamed era. TTWO/GOOGL as_of 2023-05-26 -> Alphabet Inc, CIK 0001652044, created by the October 2015 holding-company restructuring; candidate events start exactly there (2015-10-22) with nothing earlier, so no pre-restructuring Google Inc. filing is mixed in. NGS/DVN as_of 2010-03-04 -> Devon Energy Corp/DE, CIK 0001090012, one continuous filer since 1999. Checked against each CIK's actual formerNames history, not assumed. The current ticker->CIK mapping is the correct entity in all three cases.
